`src/Encina.Messaging/Choreography/*.cs` (all 8 files), `src/Encina.Messaging/MessagingServiceCollectionExtensions.cs` (absence), `src/Encina.Messaging/MessagingConfiguration.cs` (absence): the Choreography feature is pure API surface -- interfaces, an options class and error-code constants, all tracked in `PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt` -- with zero concrete implementation and zero DI registration anywhere in the repository. `grep -r "AddEncinaChoreography\|AddEncinaSagas" src/` returns no matches; `MessagingConfiguration.cs` has no `UseChoreography` property (only `UseSagas`, line 106); `AddMessagingServices`/`AddMessagingServicesCore` never reference any `Encina.Messaging.Choreography.*` type. Nobody can wire `IChoreographyEventBus` or `IChoreographyStateStore` through any supported path. Yet `docs/messaging/sagas.md:289-408` presents a complete usage example (`config.UseChoreography = true;`, `services.AddEncinaChoreography(options => ...)`) and recommends Choreography as the answer for two of its decision-table rows (lines 484, 499). Fails AGENTS.md paragraph "pay-for-what-you-use" and registration completeness ("an `AddEncina*` method that adds a service, orchestrator or hosted service... MUST also register every option type and dependency it resolves") -- inverted here, since no `AddEncina*` entry point exists at all for a feature documented as production-ready.
